Senior Data Analyst

Brightwater Energy
Melbourne VIC (Hybrid)
Full time
$120,000 – $135,000 per year + super

About the role
Brightwater Energy is growing its analytics team. You'll turn customer and network data into clear decisions for our operations leaders.

What you'll do
- Build and maintain dashboards in Power BI
- Write SQL to pull and clean data from our warehouse
- Present findings to non-technical stakeholders

What you'll bring
- 5+ years in a data analyst role
- Strong SQL
- Power BI or Tableau
- Python is a bonus
- Experience in energy or utilities would be great

Applications close 30 November 2026.
